summary: Vanillaware's hand-painted action RPG, later remade as Odin Sphere Leifthrasir.

entries.title: Odin Sphere

emulation.emulator: None for primary; PCSX2 for PS2 original

primary.why: Leifthrasir is a full remake that keeps the story intact while improving mechanics, performance, and presentation; PS4 is the highest-fidelity shipped platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play Odin Sphere Leifthrasir on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use the PS2 version only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically important original, but Leifthrasir addresses performance/mechanical issues and improves fidelity.
skip: same remake family, but PS4 is the higher-fidelity console route.
skip: complete portable route, but lower capture/fidelity ceiling than PS4.
primary: definitive remake with the best shipped presentation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Leifthrasir is both the improved-fidelity and preferred content/mechanics route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Leifthrasir is a remake with reworked gameplay; use Classic mode or PS2 only if comparing the original design.
